decisions.reason: Using the newly shared document as the authoritative revision does not explicitly change the editorial objective or either approved passage rewrite.
The authoritative revision concerns the manuscript document and does not change the paperback cover requirements.
The client does not state that the reapplied manuscript edits alter the publisher attribution or other copyright-page content.
The authoritative-document change does not alter the italics requirement, which is independently established by another clause of the same message.
Selecting an updated manuscript document does not change the requested KDP metadata, upload, or process guidance.
The revised manuscript file does not change the requested publication-readiness guidance.
The source does not identify any change to the Chapter 12 subtitle hierarchy or capitalization requirements.
The authoritative manuscript revision does not modify image-rendering quality requirements; image defects are independently reported in other clauses of the same message.
The authoritative-document change does not itself alter paragraph spacing or page-density requirements, which are independently introduced in another clause.
Selecting the revised manuscript does not change the criteria for evaluating chapter images against the book's tone or colour palette.
The revised manuscript file does not change the established placement, timing, or full-page treatment of chapter images.
The source does not state that the updated manuscript changes the title or its resolved newline-artifact formatting.
